title: What a DBA answers for, and what belongs to the developer

videos.script: Somewhere in every company there is a database that everything depends on. Orders, invoices, accounts, the lot. {{everything}} When it is fast, nobody thinks about it. When it is slow, everybody does. And when it is gone, the company stops. {{gone}} The person who answers for it is the database administrator. Not for the application on top. Not for the queries somebody wrote last week. For the server those queries run on. {{server}} Is it up. Is the data safe. Can it be restored, and has anybody tried. Who can read what. Will the disk still have room in three months. {{questions}} This course is about answering those questions on a real server, starting from an empty machine. {{course}} This first lesson draws the line between the administrator and the developer, because most of the arguments in this job happen exactly on that line. And it says what you will be able to do when the twenty-four lessons are over. {{title}}
